[EN] We've noticed the Gutrends keep their strength up by eating the {@LinkCreature:6#2011#hillwalker warthogs} and {@LinkCreature:6#2031#scavenging bears}. And us, of course, but we're already doing what we can to stay out of their food chain.

If you get out there and destroy their food source, maybe they'll finally look elsewhere and we can be rid of them.
[ES] Hemos notado que los Gutrends mantienen su fuerza comiendo {@LinkCreature:6#2011#hillwalker warthogs} y {@LinkCreature:6#2031#scavenging bears}. Y a nosotros, por supuesto, pero ya estamos haciendo lo posible por mantenernos fuera de su cadena alimentaria.

Si sales allá afuera y destruyes su fuente de alimento, tal vez finalmente busquen en otra parte y podamos librarnos de ellos.

[EN] Great! Now they'll either look somewhere else or die out trying to keep on after us.
[ES] ¡Genial! ¡Ahora o buscarán en otro lado o se extinguirán intentando seguir tras nosotros!
